intro: Hansel Heavyhands says his bunions have bunions, and he cannot do any killing with his feet in such disarray. Scrange and Burninate told him to clear out the incendosaurs of the Slag Pit, so he sends you instead to slay twenty.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Bunions, friend. Me bunions got bunions. How am I supposed to do any sort of killin' with me feet in such disarray? That's why ye're gonna help.

Scrange and Burninate tasked me to kill these things so they can send some expeditionary teams down into the Slag Pit lava pools to do some explorin'. Supposedly some incendosaurs or some such nonsense down there causin' all kinds o' problems. Now move along an' don't come back 'til the incendosaur population be extinct.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't just stand there, grab some oil and a luffa and get to scrubbin' these bunions.
Ye don't have a luffa? Well then! Perhaps it's time I sent you out to find a luffa?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I figured since ye didn't have a luffa...
